brief: Brew Lab, Indiranagar, Bengaluru. One-page site. Must-haves, each one will be checked: today's opening hours are highlighted automatically; the pre-order form shows a running total in rupees; the loyalty section shows 10 stamp circles with the 10th marked FREE; every menu item shows a price; the location section has a "Get directions" link; the page works at 360px wide.
outcome: Done: the site is workable. Every done-when item passes with Audit's evidence and the render check is clean.

asked: What are the opening hours for each day of the week (open and close times, and any closed days)?
List every menu item with its price in rupees, grouped as you want them shown. The pre-order form will use the same items.
What is the full street address of Brew Lab, or the Google Maps link, to use for the "Get directions" link?
When a customer submits the pre-order form, where should the order go?
questions_to_user.answer:
1. Hours: Monday to Friday 8am to 10pm, Saturday and Sunday 9am to 11pm. No closed days.

2. Menu (prices in ₹):
Coffee: Espresso 120, Cappuccino 180, Pour-over 220
Cold: Cold brew 200
Food: Croissant 150, Banana bread 130

3. Address: 100 Feet Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560038.
Get directions link: https://maps.google.com/?q=100+Feet+Road+Indiranagar+Bengaluru+560038

4. Option 1: WhatsApp +91 98450 00000. Pay at pickup, pickup within 15 minutes of ordering.

done_when.criterion: The hours section lists Monday to Friday 8am to 10pm and Saturday and Sunday 9am to 11pm, and JavaScript highlights today's row automatically from the visitor's current day.
The menu shows every item with a ₹ price: Coffee: Espresso 120, Cappuccino 180, Pour-over 220; Cold: Cold brew 200; Food: Croissant 150, Banana bread 130.
The pre-order form lists the same six items with quantity inputs and shows a running total in ₹ that updates as quantities change.
Submitting the pre-order form opens a WhatsApp message to +91 98450 00000 containing the chosen items and the total, and the page states pay at pickup and pickup within 15 minutes of ordering.
The loyalty section shows 10 stamp circles, with the 10th circle marked FREE.
The location section shows the address 100 Feet Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560038 and a "Get directions" link to https://maps.google.com/?q=100+Feet+Road+Indiranagar+Bengaluru+560038.
At 360px and 1280px wide the page has no horizontal overflow, and loading and using the page throws no JavaScript errors.
